北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京雾气弥漫，体感寒冷。注意交通安全，添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy and chilly. Drive safe and dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪风力较大，体感偏凉。外出记得防风，别着凉啦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is windy and feels cool. Remember to wear windproof clothing!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感微凉。湿度高，注意防潮，添件衣裳哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and cool. High humidity, mind dampness, add a layer!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州雾气蒙蒙，暖暖的。出门注意能见度，带伞备用哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is warm and foggy. Mind visibility and bring an umbrella, just in case!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，暖和舒适。湿度适中，享受美好的一天吧！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is partly cloudy, warm and pleasant. Enjoy your beautiful day!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，气温适中。注意保暖，别着凉哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy with moderate temperatures. Stay warm and don't catch a cold!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京雾大体感冷。湿度 100%，出门小心湿滑，多穿点哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is very foggy and cold. High humidity, watch for slippery roads, dress warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，温度舒适。出门记得带把伞，有备无患哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy with comfortable temps. Bring an umbrella, just in case!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴冷，体感仅 2℃。风力较大，请注意防风保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and cold, feels like 2℃. It's windy, remember windproof and warm clothes.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感偏凉。湿度较低，多喝水润润喉。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and cool. Low humidity, drink more water to moisturize your throat.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆雾气弥漫，体感舒适。注意交通安全，保持好心情！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy and comfortable. Mind traffic safety, keep a good mood!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感超冷，风也大。多穿厚衣，注意防寒防风！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels super cold and windy. Layer up, protect from cold and wind!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳有霾，体感寒冷。注意防护，出门戴好口罩保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang has haze, feels cold. Protect yourself, wear a mask and keep warm.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感凉爽。昼夜温差大，早晚注意添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is partly cloudy and cool. Big temp difference, dress for morning and night.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门雾气弥漫，暖和潮湿。出行注意安全，保持愉快心情。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is warm, foggy and humid. Travel safe, stay cheerful.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷，风力 4级。体感很凉，务必做好防风保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and cold with strong winds. Feels very chilly, be sure to layer up!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连下雪了，体感 -6℃！风也大，出门注意防滑防寒哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is snowing, feels like -6℃! It's windy, watch for slippery roads and keep warm!
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃
